instructions: Run the mission's printed walk-start command first. Start from the fresh dedicated test machine without a source checkout; use supplied controller context to drive the target. Install the application candidate as a new user and choose your own sequence through the terminal, browser and real desktop. Explore welcome and prerequisite framing, PATH diagnosis and repair, review and apply behavior, successful handoff, credential-file permissions without reading credentials, and resulting application status. Look for confusing, broken, missing, unsafe or unnecessarily difficult behavior. Follow the product as a user would; do not turn these landmarks into a scripted checklist. After candidate installation, verify each browser identity the mission names with the dispatch's exact `yoke browser verify` command before browsing as it. Agents perform every step an agent physically can: open each interactive session through the native GUI/desktop route on the leased desktop, choose its permission mode, type codes into wizards, and approve machine-connect and device codes in the already signed-in browser or with `yoke machines approve CODE`. Only entering the user's own password or credential is a human gate. Explore an agent install inside a Claude, Codex and Cursor session the walker opens through the native GUI/desktop route, recording the installed native build and every available permission mode. Choose your own order within these landmarks; do not create an exhaustive feature matrix. Interactive sessions are opened on the desktop, never automatically launched. Return a precise human gate only for personal approval. Observe actual registration, a real hook firing, exactly one orientation and the active-session readiness checks (registration, signed-in active harness and unattended permissions); unrelated installed harnesses must not block it. Use the focused install health result when shipped, otherwise record equivalent observations explicitly. From cold no-project and unrelated new/existing project contexts, find installed help, a complete recipe and its deeper home with no private Yoke source checkout. Capture sanitized receiving-model context, measure the combined delivery against the installed manifest limit including required messages/recovery, and distinguish installed files from model receipt. Follow representative activation beyond setup: a new project with no GitHub and a mature project with existing work. Build the mature project during this walk without a baseline or pre-existing fixture: clone a small public repository with real commit history, add a few existing tasks or issues in its own work-tracking files, then install Yoke into that repository. Create Yoke projects only by installing them. Establish useful strategy, CURRENT-PLAN and relevant initiative documents; let steering create meaningful work and follow its pinned workflow until the first item is actually done with the required checks, approvals and delivery. Fold interruption/resume and a second machine into these archetypes; preserve the project choices while checking the second machine independently. Do not require an optional capability absent from the selected work. Stop at a real refusal rather than fabricating readiness, delivery or a terminal transition.
expected_outcome: Return a ranked, actionable report grounded in observed behavior, with enough detail to reproduce each finding. Name every important area that could not be verified and why. Use available declared substrates, discard routine perception and stay within the runtime-supplied artifact limit using only deliberate proof. Create Yoke projects only by installing them on the Test Machine, and before returning pass or fail run the mission's printed walk-end command, which uninstalls, cancels and retires them. Name any disposal blocker walk-end reports and its recovery. If a password or credential entry the agent may not type is needed, return immediately with WALK_STATUS: HUMAN_GATE naming that one entry and resume state. Handle permission dialogs and sign-ins yourself, or route approvals to steering. For each attempted harness/mode/context, record release/build, observed hook and registration, orientation count, receiving-model context size and source, installed guidance route, readiness result and recoverable gap. Activation proof names project/onboarding run, useful documents, steering-created item, exact workflow/completion obligations, required QA/approval evidence and actual done status; merge is enough only when that workflow says so. Unknown, unavailable, failed and human-gated observations never count as passes. Record newly observed failures as reproducible regressions for the scripted campaign; do not store QA outcomes in capability manifests. Preserve original observations when rerunning after a related installer/setup/onboarding change.
